fields.name: Vṛndāvana Cakravartī (disciple of Satyabhāmā)
fields.notes:
He was the disciple of Satyabhāmā Devī, the daughter-in-law of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya.

The record also held the Vṛndāvana Cakravartī disciple of Kṛṣṇadeva Sārvabhauma, commentator of the Govinda-līlāmṛta, now in a record of its own (07-11-2026).
Taken out of the record «Vṛndāvana Cakravartī» #1742, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).
